discovery.goal: Implement a reusable observed text-asset resolver in contextual_asset_resolver.mjs, with independently meaningful closest tests. Read proposal.json and the observed Rust projection/translation sources first. Support only ReuseExistingAsset initially: an explicit default import with exactly type=text, actual source and asset identities, explicit destination context, permitted root ownership and target-relative existing asset path. Preserve unknown effects, reject context-free imports, missing or drifted source/assets, duplicate/unknown/nontext attributes, escaping or outside-root symlinks and ambiguous bindings before writing target artifacts. Prove moved destinations, aliases, Unicode paths and exact content with actual selected fixtures; no Transport implementation, invented asset or emitted Rust wrapper. This is selected-file scratch only; production sources/seed/ratchets and native compilation are out of scope. Report precise MissingContract gaps if source-backed implementation is unsupported.
